# Styluxe Salons

Styluxe Salons is a modern Indian luxury unisex salon brand delivering expert hair artistry, botanical skincare, precision men's grooming, bridal makeup, and nail care at affordable luxury pricing, along with turnkey salon franchise opportunities across India.
